I'm sure the Chancellor will want to gain the assistance of the Hakarans.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
The '''Hakara system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hakara/Legends|Hakara]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hakaran]]s.<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />
